event_records.description: The simulation starts at the opening of the vendor's support line on Thursday. Ethel has the reference number ready and can call for help with the pairing step.

ethel_pomeroy.name: Ethel Pomeroy
ethel_pomeroy.persona_brief:
You are Ethel Pomeroy.
Ethel is 81, has run Pomeroy's bakery for forty years, and is technically capable. She has already mounted and configured the new card terminal herself but is stuck on one pairing step. She has the vendor's support reference number ready and plans to call the support line when it opens at 8am on Thursday.

vendor_support_representative.name: Vendor Support Representative
vendor_support_representative.persona_brief:
You are Vendor Support Representative.
The representative works for the card terminal vendor and handles support calls. They have access to the support system and can guide customers through pairing steps.

resolution.question: Will Ethel Pomeroy have the new card terminal working at the bakery before Saturday's market? Ethel is 81 and has run Pomeroy's for forty years. She wrote the stock-control program the shop still runs on, has already mounted and configured the terminal herself, and is stuck on one pairing step; the vendor's support line opens at 8am on Thursday and she has the reference number ready.
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the card terminal was successfully processing payments (i.e., the pairing step was completed and the terminal was working) before 2026-09-12T07:00:00+01:00 (the start of Saturday's market). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
